description: This file is a shell script used for testing compatibility of object formats in git repositories, involving setup of repositories, creation of commits, tags, and verification of object identifiers across different hash functions.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Returns the corresponding hash algorithm for a given hash type (sha1 or sha256).

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a 'hello' object based on the hash type.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a 'tree' object based on the hash type.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a 'commit' object based on the hash type.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Returns the object ID for a second 'commit' object based on the hash type.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a commit object, depending on the hash type.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes the signature from a tag object, depending on storage and hash type.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Compares object IDs and properties across repositories for consistency between different hash formats.
